title: Today's General Counsel spotlights Burford Quarterly article on data-driven litigation valuation
summary: Today's General Counsel spotlights a Burford Quarterly article by Philipp Leibfried, managing director and head of Europe, and James MacKinnon, director, on using data-driven valuation frameworks to assess litigation risk and support more informed settlement decisions. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Today's General Counsel spotlights a *Burford Quarterly*[article](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/settle-smarter-how-data-and-valuation-reframe-high-stakes-disputes/) by[Philipp Leibfried](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/philipp-leibfried/) , managing director and head of Europe, and[James MacKinnon](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/james-mackinnon/) , director, on using data-driven valuation frameworks to assess litigation risk and support more informed settlement decisions.


Read the full article[here](https://todaysgeneralcounsel.com/data-driven-valuations-lead-to-bigger-wins-in-litigation/) .
